import random


def from_match(flag: bool) -> random.Random:
    seed: int | None
    match flag:
        case True:
            seed = None
        case _:
            seed = 1
    return random.Random(seed)


def from_try() -> random.Random:
    seed: int | None
    try:
        seed = None
    except ValueError:
        seed = 1
    return random.Random(seed)


def from_loop(flags: list[bool]) -> random.Random:
    seed: int | None = 1
    for flag in flags:
        if flag:
            seed = None
        else:
            seed = 1
    return random.Random(seed)
